parameters.name: principal_id
parameters.description: Repeatable principal id to scope the listing by. Intersected with the caller's visible principals server-side; out-of-scope ids are silently dropped. Used by the Media Archive plugin's `ALL / My Media / Group X` chip row. Use the `principal_id[]=…` array-bracket form so repeated keys are preserved through PHP parse_str.
